gate_refusal_reason: a 5% false-promotion gate cannot be scored on 300 null worlds: the 95% binomial interval there is about +-0.025, wider than the quantity being gated. This stage reports sensitivity to selection, not a certified rate.
scope_note: One generator family, four frozen recipes, one capacity. The comparison is one-versus-four candidates on identical predictions, so it isolates the cost of selecting rather than of modelling.
